verses.52:21: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَٱتَّبَعَتۡهُمۡ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلۡحَقۡنَا بِهِمۡ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ وَمَآ أَلَتۡنَٰهُم مِّنۡ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَيۡءࣲۚ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيِٕۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينࣱ‏

meaning: The root ألت (Alt) primarily means to decrease, diminish, or lessen something. It also signifies to defraud someone of their right or property.
en_note: Statistically derived from translation co-occurrence, not a lexical definition. Highlighting only.
